newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cosmo Oil says cuts refinery throughput by 1-2 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cosmo Oil says cuts refinery throughput by 1-2 pct.

text.p: Cosmo Oil Co Ltd said on Monday it had cut crude throughput at its refineries by one to two percent over the past week because of high product inventories and lacklustre sales in the past two months.
"The cuts reflect a natural easing because of the high level of product inventories we are currently experiencing in Japan," a Cosmo Oil spokesman said.
"We also experienced slightly lower consumer demand in the months of April and May," he added.

Cosmo's four refineries include a 155,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) facility in Yokkaichi, central Japan, a 240,000 bpd plant in Chiba near Tokyo, a 110,000 bpd plant in Sakai and a 140,000 bpd refinery in Sakaide, both in western Japan.
